subject: Newsletter mentions as a Common Room signal
body:
Your integrations page describes Common Room merging signals "from 50+ channels, spanning social, community, product, code collaboration, CRM, and more". Public newsletters are not named among those channels, and for B2B companies they are often where an account surfaces first: a founder essay, a guest appearance, a sponsor read.

NewsletterFIT indexes more than 27,000 public newsletter publications and 143,000 articles, with company, people, topic and sponsor extraction, each record carrying the publication, the article URL and the date. That is the part your custom API, Zapier and warehouse paths cannot source on their own: publication-level metadata, sponsor relationships and mention history.

Would a sample help? I can send 20 accounts as rows shaped to your signal schema, with publication, mention type, sponsor and timestamp, so your team can judge fit before any integration conversation.
